turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
Mm-hm. Go on.
After the fight I sat in the car for an hour and thought about driving into the river.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I think so, yes.
Tell me more about that.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
Take your time.
I promised her I will go to a Gamblers Anonymous meeting on Thursday.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Take your time.
She said she will take Arjun to her sister's in Birmingham if I do not get help.
And how was that for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
Meera found a loan letter in the post and confronted me last night, and I admitted everything.
What went through your mind then?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. Yes, it was like that.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
